method: Matched repeat of all 100 benchmark3 questions on the same unchanged synthetic fixture, first attempt per release. Known-question regression evaluation, not an unseen generalization score. No code changes during the run; no retries replace failures. All ten categories and five follow-up pairs retained.
grading: Native boolean types are required only when explicitly requested. Plain-text bullet markers on separate rendered lines count as bullets; semantic list rendering is also verified. Do not penalize omitted gold context that was not requested.
accountPlan: Effective Plus QA, five-year window; free-tier production UI not measured.

budget.stopRule: Check cost every ten questions; stop starting turns at $3.50 run delta, reserving $0.50 for any started batch. Aggregate new spend must remain below $10.
